title: Audit Service Database Schema
description: Persistence schema for the Audit Service (SQL Server)

Id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

FacilityId.description: ID of the facility associated with the action

Action.description: The action performed (e.g., Create, Update, Delete)

Resource.description: The resource affected by the action

User.description: The user who performed the action

PropertyChanges.description: List of changes made to the resource properties
